# Noir Peptides

> Noir Peptides supplies batch-documented peptide reference materials for
> laboratory research use only. All products are sold strictly for in-vitro
> research by qualified purchasers and are NOT for human or veterinary use, and
> are not drugs, supplements, or medical products. Access to the product catalog
> requires an account and a research-use attestation.

## Public, indexable content

- [Home](https://www.noirpeptides.com/): brand overview (research-use only).
- [Research & Education](https://www.noirpeptides.com/research): claim-safe
  educational articles on certificates of analysis, HPLC purity, and how
  peptide reference materials are studied in the laboratory.
- [Deals & Bundle Pricing](https://www.noirpeptides.com/deals): public promo codes + volume ladder.
- [Concentration Calculator](https://www.noirpeptides.com/calculator): a pure
  mass-per-volume (mg ÷ mL) laboratory aliquoting reference — no dosing.
- [Research-Use Policy](https://www.noirpeptides.com/legal/research-use-policy)
- [FDA Disclaimer](https://www.noirpeptides.com/legal/fda-disclaimer)
- [Terms](https://www.noirpeptides.com/legal/terms) ·
  [Privacy](https://www.noirpeptides.com/legal/privacy) ·
  [Shipping & Refunds](https://www.noirpeptides.com/legal/shipping)

## Not available to crawlers

The product catalog, certificates of analysis, account, cart, checkout, and AI
research tools are behind an authentication + attestation wall and are
intentionally excluded from indexing (see /robots.txt).

## Compliance

Educational content is descriptive and claim-safe: it never makes human-use,
dosing, therapeutic, or disease-treatment claims, and never implies FDA
approval. Materials are for research use only.
